settings.faq_content:
What is Ruck On Club?
It's the house club — where you land if you don't ruck with a gym or crew of your own. Same membership, same benefits; the patch carries the Ruck On name.

Do members of other clubs get less?
No. Every member gets the same four benefits. The only thing that changes between clubs is whose name is on the patch.

How does the 10% discount work?
It applies store wide for as long as your membership is active — every order, on everything we make.

When am I billed?
Today, and on the same date each month. Cancel anytime before your next renewal.

Can I switch clubs later?
Yes. Get in touch and we'll move you over from your next patch onward.
